SELECT s.name
FROM Student s
JOIN (
    SELECT liked_id, COUNT(*) AS like_count
    FROM Likes
    GROUP BY liked_id
) l ON s.id = l.liked_id
WHERE l.like_count = (
    SELECT MAX(like_count)
    FROM (
        SELECT COUNT(*) AS like_count
        FROM Likes
        GROUP BY liked_id
    ) AS counts
);
